title: Spyglass: Officially Launched!
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, transitioning from beta to a powerful new experience ready for everyone.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: You can now effortlessly manage, upload, download, and customize the display of your files directly within the editor for richer content creation.

title: Introducing the Noeko Public Roadmap!
summary: Discover our dynamic new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into recently shipped features, upcoming releases, and future innovations planned for our platform.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes easier to use, better looking, and fully draggable for a more seamless task management experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience more seamless and intuitive teamwork with our upgraded collaboration features, designed to make working with others in real-time effortless.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Discovery for Shared Items
summary: We've significantly improved the visibility and utility of shared content, making it easier for you to discover and collaborate with others more effectively.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: Soon, Noeko will speak your language, enabling a truly global and localized experience for everyone.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're excited to open source Noeko's codebase, offering our community greater control, transparency, and direct involvement in shaping the project's future.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented precision and collaboration thanks to new filtering options and seamless sharing capabilities within your Constellation view.

title: Advanced Search & Curated Collections
summary: Discover and organize your knowledge with unprecedented precision using advanced filters and sorting options, then effortlessly save your refined searches as custom Compendiums for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: Experience a more intuitive and flexible way to structure your notes with enhanced previews and interactive display options for linked content.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Experience greater control and unlock powerful new features with the upcoming launch of Noeko's self-hosting capability and flexible premium plans.

title: Elevated Visual Themes
summary: Prepare for a stunning new look as we enhance all current themes and roll out an exciting selection of fresh visual styles designed to elevate your experience.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're refining our homepage greetings to always reflect the precise time of day, ensuring a more personalized and welcoming start to your experience.

title: Quick Actions for Tagged Items
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items directly within the tag view, empowering you to quickly remove items and perform other essential actions without tedious navigation.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Hub with Diverse Content
summary: Get ready to effortlessly import and interact with a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, transforming your platform into a truly universal knowledge hub.
